Lanterns.title: Pilot
Lanterns.description: After a fatal shooting, Green Lantern, Hal Jordan, and new recruit John Stewart set out to prove it was an extra terrestrial event.

Lanterns.title: Trust Fall
Lanterns.description: While John's middling errand ultimately proves eventful, Hal makes waves in Rushville – which only inspires him to dig deeper.

Lanterns.title: OutKast
Lanterns.description: When his father misinterprets the Guardians' contact, John becomes the next choice for Green Lantern. After years of preparation, he finally gets to interview with the Guardians.

Lanterns.title: The Weenie
Lanterns.description: With the 48-hour deadline about to expire, John develops a new theory about the whereabouts of the Cosmic Hunter, which leads him and Hal to present their next plan to Sheriff Kane. Meanwhile, Hal's visit to Sinestro has consequences.

Lanterns.title: Lights Out
Lanterns.description: As the Macon family's history unravels, Rushville mobilizes in the face of the escalating threat. As John is placed in an impossible position, Hal risks everything in a final attempt to take down the Manhunter.

Lanterns.title: Bad Optics
Lanterns.description: John partners with brother Marcus to land a major investor for his panic room innovation, but an unexpected call pulls him back to Rushville and his past.

Lanterns.title: The Jordan Boys' Legacy
Lanterns.description: Hal and John find themselves on another planet and must put aside their past to solve a murder. Meanwhile, they are forced to confront the way their childhood shaped who they are today.

Lanterns.title: Dirt and Stars
Lanterns.description: As John and Hal draw closer to the truth, John comes to an unexpected understanding with Sheriff Kane - just as a chilling new discovery emerges.
